title: Cancellation and Schröder–Bernstein for Torsion Abelian Groups
exact_target: Do the two cancellation principles for countable torsion abelian groups each require analytic comprehension? When the groups have no divisible part, do they instead each require arithmetic transfinite recursion?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 7500112 (AMR-074-0112). CC BY 4.0.
